violation_type.title: Special Diets - Written Approval from Health Care Professional or Dietician if not Related to Disability (26 TAC §746.3311(a)(1)(B))
violation_type.short_title: Special Diets - Written Approval from Health Care Professional or Dietician if not Related to Disability
violation_type.typical_finding: When reviewing children's files, the children with food intolerances did not have documentation from health care provider or dietician.

finding_variants.text: When reviewing children's files, the children with food intolerances did not have documentation from health care provider or dietician.
Letters from a health-care professional were given to the operation from a parent. The health-care professional recommendations were not followed.
